candidates.change_summary: Delete the `require` statement so anyone can call withdraw.
Replace the owner check with `require(msg.sender != Owner)` to reverse access control.
Remove the require(msg.sender == Owner) check, allowing any caller to execute arbitrary calls.
Replace adr.call with a call to a different address (Owner) while keeping the same data, changing the target of the call.
Replace the low-level call with a transfer of the contract's entire balance to the caller, changing the external effect completely.
Replace msg.value with 0 in the call, so no ETH is forwarded regardless of what was sent.
Delete the entire body of Command, making it a no-op that returns successfully without performing any external call.
